thesis: Diverse traditions illuminate character, roles, duty, consequences, power and hidden care without yielding a linear moral history.

ideas.statement: Choices under pressure and relational duties resist a simple free-or-forced model.
Respect for persons and attention to outcomes constrain each other.
Division of labor and hidden care distribute dependence and moral burdens.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Family loyalty can be care at home and favoritism in public selection.
Practical wisdom concerns worthy ends as well as instrumental skill.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: No single genealogy or homogeneous Eastern mentality is claimed.

audit.notes: All assigned units read. Claims remain bounded; hypothetical cases are not empirical evidence.
